---
title: 'Min-Time Escape of a Dubins Car from a Polygon'
authors:
  - 'Isaac E. Weintraub'
  - 'Alexander Von Moll'
  - 'David Casbeer'
  - 'Satyanarayana G Manyam'
  - 'Meir Pachter'
  - 'Colin Taylor'
image: 'featured.jpg'
abstract: |
  A turn constrained vehicle is initially located inside a polygon region and
  desires to escape in minimum time. First, the method of characteristics is
  used to describe the time-optimal strategies for reaching a line of infinite
  length. Next, the approach is extended to polygons constructed of a series of
  line segments. Using this construction technique, the min-time path to reach
  each edge is obtained; the resulting minimum of the set of optimal
  trajectories is then selected for escaping the polygon.
